Build smarter, enterprise-ready AI with SQL Ontologies

Enable LLMs – Large Language Models and autonomous agents to interact seamlessly with structured, governed, and contextualized data, by leveraging ontology modeling, relationships, SQL measures, and virtualization.

LEARN ABOUT TIMBR'S ENTERPRISE LLM DATA FOUNDATION
  • Unify structured data into a semantic graph for precise context.
  • Empower LLMs with accurate, governed, real-time answers.
  • Accelerate development with SDKs for seamless integration into apps, copilots, and workflows.
LEARN ABOUT TIMBR'S ENTERPRISE LLM FOUNDATION

Simplify your Journey
from Data to Knowledge

  • Model data semantically with SQL ontologies.
  • Define reusable semantic metrics.
  • Replace complex JOINs with semantic relationships.
  • Benefit from hierarchies and classifications.
  • Apply business rules using logic and math operators.

Decouple BI from Data

  • Reuse common metrics across tools.
  • Replace static views with dynamic concepts and data mappings.
  • Update the data structure without disrupting workflows.
  • Push down compute from BI to CDW.
  • Avoid lock-in of data stores and consumption tools.
  • Accelerate cloud migration.
  • Build easier to maintain systems.

Accelerate Time to Value

  • Fast, convenient implementation.
  • Smart, AI-assisted ontology modeling.
  • Reduced time-to-consumption by up to 90%.
  • SQL: Open, accessible, no need to learn new paradigms or complex languages.

Deploy Where your Data Lives

  • SaaS, cloud or on-premises.
  • Available on Azure, GCP and AWS.
  • Containerized in Kubernetes.
